caption: The drawing depicts a single long, full-sleeved garment colored primarily in shades of green with hints of yellow and blue, giving the appearance of a textured fabric. The garment has a high, rounded neckline with a short vertical opening at the center of the chest, and a long central opening that extends down the length of the robe, lined with what appears to be a subtle trim or seam detail. The sleeves are fitted and end with wide cuffs featuring a slit or opening detail. There is some gathered or pleated detail just below the bust, creating shaping in the bodice area. In the upper right corner, there is an additional simple line drawing that shows the same garment from the back, indicating gathered fabric at the upper back and fullness in the skirt. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color.
title: Evening Dress
